note: Triennial election of the rural district council, polled on Thursday 4 June 1964. The returning officer's Notice of Result of Elections (dated 4 June 1964) lists all 16 district electoral divisions: polls in Carrickfergus Rural and Glynn, 13 members elected unopposed, and in Middle Division no nomination, the retiring member deemed to be re-elected. Returned unopposed.
